Service 03 · Most Popular
Most Popular 10 to 15 business days

GHL + AI Receptionist

$1,799
One time implementation

Never make a caller wait for someone to pick up. Your inbound Voice AI can answer business questions, qualify callers, book appointments, and live transfer the right opportunities to your team.

What you get
  • Everything in GoHighLevel Setup
  • Inbound Voice AI receptionist
  • Business Q&A + knowledge training
  • Lead qualification + information capture
  • Appointment booking + calendar checks
  • Live transfer + human escalation
  • Up to 10 automation workflows
  • Call testing, tuning + 30 day support
Voice AI scope: Inbound phone calls only. It does not reply to SMS, email, chat, or contact responses inside the CRM.
Result: Your business can keep answering, qualifying, and booking inbound callers even when your team cannot pick up.
Best for businesses losing opportunities because calls are missed, delayed, or handled inconsistently.
Service 04 · Complete System
Complete System 15 to 20 business days

GHL AI Revenue System

$2,999
One time implementation

Turn GHL into an AI powered conversion engine. Inbound Voice AI handles new calls, while Outbound Voice AI proactively follows up with leads, checks interest, qualifies them, and drives the next step.

What you get
  • Everything in GHL + AI Receptionist
  • Outbound Voice AI outreach + qualification

All prices are one-time implementation fees. GoHighLevel subscription, AI usage, phone/SMS charges, domain fees, premium hosting, and paid third-party services are billed separately when applicable.

Turnaround starts after required access, intake details, content, and assets are received. Outbound AI outreach must follow applicable consent and calling rules.
